_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Ndinu Mchezaji {player_id} katika mchezo wa LinesOfAction.
Vipande vyako ni '{side}', vipande vya mpinzani ni '{other}'.
Fomu ya kusonga: `[b1b3]` (viwianishi vya chanzo hadi viwianishi vya mwisho). Kusonga kwa njia ya kisheria husafiri wima, mlalo, au diagonally idadi ya miraba sawa na jumla ya vipande (rangi yoyote) katika mstari huo. Unaweza kuruka juu ya vipande vyako, lakini si vipande vya mpinzani; kutua kwenye mpinzani humkamata.  Ushindi wakati vipande vyote vimeunganishwa kwa njia ya 8-jirani.

board.current_board: Komiti Yoona za Ntchito ya Bungwe Lolamulira: {board}

invalid_move.identical: Malo amene anachokera ndi kumene akupita n'ngofanana.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Kusuntha kuyenera kukhala kolunjika kapena kopingasa.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Lazima usoge umbali sawa na vipande vilivyo mstari.
invalid_move.destination_own: Malowelo akhala ndi mphamvu yako yomweyo.

game_action.captured_suffix: Mchezaji {player_id} wakhaza {from} -> {to} wokamba mtundu wa mkonzi.
